summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi MARA 2x Daily ETF (MHX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of MARA Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: MARA), through derivatives such as swaps MHX was launched on Jul 14, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
